sess.title: Active sessions
sess.panelTitle: Where your account is signed in
sess.intro: Every device connected to your Nextendo account shows up here — browser, Ryujinx emulator, or Nintendo Switch. You can disconnect one remotely, or close them all at once.
sess.closeAllHint: “Close all sessions” disconnects all your devices — including this browser. Useful if you think someone else has access to your account.
sess.confirmMeText: You'll need to sign in again on this browser.
sess.confirmOtherText: This device will be disconnected from your Nextendo account. On Ryujinx or the Switch, a message will prompt to sign in again.
sess.confirmAllText: All your devices will be disconnected, including this browser. You'll need to sign in again everywhere.

acc.verifyBanner: Confirm your email address. We sent you a verification link when you created your account. Without it, you won't be able to recover your password if you forget it.
acc.plugRyujinx: On Ryujinx : open Actions → Nextendo Network login, enter your credentials, then launch a supported game and go to its online menu.
acc.plugSwitch: On Switch (CFW) : enable the Nextendo profile (DNS redirect), connect this account, and play. Your profile picture and nickname follow you.
acc.securityIntro: Manage your password, email address and the devices connected to your account.
acc.friendsHint: Share your friend code so your friends can add you — you'll meet online in your games.
acc.historyEmpty: No history yet — your playtime will appear here after you play (synced automatically from the emulator).
acc.savesGate: Verify your email or link your Discord account to enable cloud saves.
acc.savesUnsupported: Preview is not available for this game.
acc.savesIdle: Select a save to load its preview.
acc.toastResent: Verification email resent — check your inbox.

ed.title: Edit profile
ed.photoSub: Profile picture <hint>— layer a character, a background and a frame</hint>
ed.badPseudo: Invalid nickname: 3 to 16 characters (letters, digits, _ or -).

fr.noHistory: This friend has no public game history yet.
fr.empty: No friends yet. Add another player's friend code.
fr.confirmRemove: Remove this friend from your list?
fr.confirmBlock: Block this player? They'll be removed from your friends and won't be able to send you a request.

em.title: Change email address
em.intro: Your new address will need to be confirmed by email. Until then, your account becomes “unverified” again.
em.needPw: Enter your current password to confirm.
em.toastChanged: Email changed — confirm it via the link sent to {email}.

del.title: Delete my account
del.warn: This action is irreversible. Your nickname, PID, e-mail and Discord are freed, you are removed from everyone's friends list, and you lose access. A “deleted” record is kept for moderation.

adm.deletedIntro: Trace of accounts deleted by their owners (identifiers already freed).
adm.title: Administration
adm.searchPh: Filter (nickname, email, Discord, friend code, IP)…
adm.confirmDeleteText: The account “{name}” (PID {pid}) will be deleted PERMANENTLY. Its email and friend code become free again.
adm.confirmBanText: The account “{name}” (PID {pid}) will be deleted and banned PERMANENTLY: its email, its sign-up IP and its friend code are reserved (impossible to create a new one), its cloud saves and history are erased, and if it linked its Discord it will also be banned from the Discord server.
adm.confirmUnbanText: The ban on “{name}” (PID {pid}) will be lifted: its email, its sign-up IP and its friend code become free again, and if it was banned from Discord it will be unbanned there. The account itself stays deleted — they'll have to create a new one, which the ban was preventing.

forgot.metaDesc: Reset your Nextendo Network account password — we'll email you a secure link.
forgot.asideLede: Enter your account's email address. We'll send you a secure link to choose a new password — it expires in one hour.
forgot.point2: Your friend code and friends are kept
forgot.cardSub: We'll email you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has just been sent. Check your inbox (and spam).

reset.asideLede: Choose a strong password — at least 8 characters, a digit and a special character. It replaces the old one right away.
reset.point2: You'll stay signed in to your games
reset.cardSub: Enter it twice to avoid typos.
reset.errNoToken: Invalid link: no token. Request a new one from “Forgot password”.

footer.tag: Switch online, given back to the community.
footer.legal: Nextendo Network is an independent community project, with no affiliation with Nintendo Co., Ltd. “Nintendo Switch” and “Ryujinx” belong to their respective owners. No games or ROMs are provided or distributed.

index.metaTitle: Nextendo Network — Switch online, given back to the community
index.metaDesc: Nextendo Network reimplements the Nintendo Switch online services for the Ryujinx emulator. Accounts, online play, friends and communities.

hero.title: An <hl>independent</hl> network for your Switch.
hero.lede: Nextendo Network reimplements the Switch's online services for the Ryujinx emulator.

statement.text: When an official service shuts down, online play dies with it. <soft>Nextendo brings it back, cleanly and in the open.</soft>

features.title: Online, rewritten cleanly.
features.lede: A clear, polished stack built to last. Not an obscure copy of the original servers.

accounts.p: An identity independent from the official servers. Keep your friends and your online presence from one game to the next.

online.p: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, Splatoon 2, Super Smash Bros. Ultimate: the multiplayer modes, from Ryujinx or your Switch.

friends.p: See who's online, what they're playing, and jump into the game.

community.p: A non-profit project, made by and for the community.

privacy.p: No tracking, no reselling. Your games stay yours.

arch.title: How Nextendo connects you.
arch.lede: Your game talks to our servers just like it talked to the original ones. We handle identity, friends and matchmaking — the match itself is played live between players.

game.p: Ryujinx or a Switch on CFW. The game isn't modified.

account.p: Your identity and a signed token take the place of the original servers.

match.p: Our open servers pair you up; the match then goes P2P between players.

install.title: Online in four steps.
install.lede: On the Ryujinx emulator or a real Switch on CFW. Either way, your Nextendo account is the key — and everything is reversible.
install.hint: Your network identity: a nickname, a permanent friend code, and your friends — shared across all your games and devices.

step1.p: Free, in three fields. You instantly get a permanent nickname and friend code.

step2.p: The emulator build preconfigured for our network. On a Switch CFW, enable the Nextendo profile instead (DNS redirect).

step3.p: In Ryujinx: Actions → Connect to Nextendo Network, then enter your credentials.

step4.p: Launch Mario Kart 8, Splatoon 2 or Smash Ultimate, open the online menu, and find the community.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.a1: No. It's an independent community project. No affiliation, sponsorship or endorsement from Nintendo Co., Ltd.
faq.q2: Do I have to provide games?
faq.a2: Nextendo distributes no games, ROMs or keys. The project only provides network services. You remain responsible for your own copies.
faq.a3: The priority is Ryujinx. Other environments may follow as the community contributes.
faq.q4: What do you do with my data?
faq.a4: The bare minimum to run the service. No tracking, no reselling. The code is open, so you can check it.
faq.a5: Code, translation, compatibility testing or moderation: it all helps. Join the repo and the community server to get started.

cta.title: Ready to plug your Switch back in?
cta.lede: Follow development, join the community, and start your first online match.
